I sat down with Hector to break down how entrepreneurs can start profitable online trade schools using government grants that can cover a student’s entire tuition. We talked about how he generated $2.4 million in his first year, why online courses can reach margins as high as 80–90%, and how people can white label existing training instead of creating a course from scratch. Hector also explained the licensing process, startup costs, how to find students before grant approval, and why trade schools can create a valuable hiring pipeline for existing service businesses. Finally, we discussed why skilled trades like forklift repair, EV repair, and appliance repair could remain AI-proof for decades. 

Enjoy!
